title: Khirbet ‘Almit
author: G. Lipowitz, Z. Ehrlich, A. Mazar and U. Dinur (communicated by U. Dinur)
tier1_record: IAA notices on Kh. ‘Almit (arrival register README step 5); read after the freeze; extraction only
notes: Tier-1 record. EVIDENCE extracted (no comparison made): one rock-cut tomb, entrance 0.6 x 0.6 m facing south, square entrance chamber with bench, trapezoidal burial chamber with shelves and two bone pits; finds mostly 5th c. BCE, rest Iron II, Roman, Byzantine; stone ossuary fragments. Five burial and habitation caves found in 1973; one living or storage cave with Persian pottery and yhd/yrslm handles. No pit, cistern or opening with tombs at its mouth is described.
